bounded_host_request.command: set -u; output=$(docker exec -e AREA_ENTRY_REPAIR_APPLY=enabled -e AREA_ENTRY_REPAIR_LIMIT=1 deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/reconcileAreaEntries.mjs 2>&1); code=$?; if test "$code" -eq 0; then exit 0; fi; if printf '%s' "$output" | grep -Eqi '429|too many requests|retry after'; then exit 71; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q AREA_THREAD_PROBE_MISMATCH; then exit 72; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q AREA_THREAD_PROBE_DELETE_FAILED; then exit 73; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q TOPIC_ENTRY_NEEDS_RECONCILE; then exit 74; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q TOPIC_ENTRY_BOT_PIN_PERMISSION_REQUIRED; then exit 75; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -Eqi 'message thread not found|TOPIC.*NOT_FOUND|message_thread_id'; then exit 76; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -Eqi 'connection|timeout|ETIMEDOUT'; then exit 77; elif printf '%s' "$output" | grep -q AREA_ENTRY_REPAIR_FAILURE; then exit 78; else exit 79; fi
